shared_or_similar_visual_information: A small square angle marker inside a triangle vertex
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It indicates that AB is perpendicular to BC, forming a right angle at B. Right image: It indicates that the left vertical side is perpendicular to the upper horizontal side, forming a right angle at the upper-left vertex.
Rationales: Despite different fills and vertex locations, both squares explicitly mark a right angle in a triangle.
